name: hbc-tex-desk
description: Personal Codex bridge for disk-native TeX workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Work on the same local TeX papers from Codex and your editor.
interface.longDescription: Personal, unbranded tooling for reading, editing, linting, compiling, proofing, and exporting the disk-native TeX workspaces used by the local editor.
defaultPrompt: Open my current TeX paper, check it, and help me revise it safely.
